{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the distribution of converted by channel
conversion_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_by_channel)

# Check if the groups are comparable — cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment']))"}
